AXIOM assets

- workspace.png: actual AXIOM 1.0 installed-app capture, copied from E:/AXIOM/.qa/installed/desktop.png; built-in Hooke’s law example, no personal experimental data.
- experiment.svg: plot of the twelve observations in AXIOM examples/弹簧的胡克定律.csv.
- space-grotesk.woff2: Space Grotesk 700 Latin, @fontsource package; see FONT-LICENSE.txt.
